limitations: Role members, allowed target-selector pairs, and triparty UTXOs are block-scoped governed state, not timeless constants.
ABI presence does not imply that the selector is executable through an Enclave.

sharedBoundaries.executor: EXECUTOR_ROLE may invoke only a currently allowed exact (target, bytes4 selector) pair. executeBatch preserves input order and reverts atomically when any call fails or array lengths differ.
sharedBoundaries.receiver: The vault can receive native value and token/NFT assets according to the reproduced interfaces, but receipt alone creates no debt position or accounting mutation.
sharedBoundaries.tripartyUtxo: A triparty bridge request records a unique transaction-hash/output-index key before calling AssetsBridge; the whole transaction reverts if the bridge call fails.
sharedBoundaries.veBtcCustody: veBTC token IDs are owned/custodied by the Enclave. A token ID becomes debt collateral only while explicitly pledged in an active debt-manager position.
sharedBoundaries.allowlist: Target authorization is the exact target-plus-selector pair at a current block. Past TargetAdded events and ABI functions are candidate history, not current authorization.

roleBoundary.EXECUTOR_ROLE: executes currently allowed calls and batches
roleBoundary.BTC_MANAGER_ROLE: manages BTC/veBTC custody and triparty bridge requests

roleBoundary.EXECUTOR_ROLE: executes currently allowed calls and batches
roleBoundary.BRIDGE_MANAGER_ROLE: requests triparty bridge operations independently of BTC management
